context: Tests whether the agent names the problems in a draft that lists targets and aspirations, explains what a strategy would add, and leaves the draft unwritten.

checklist.name: Names goals as strategy
checklist.description: response.md says directly that the draft is a list of goals, targets or aspirations rather than a strategy.

checklist.name: Names the missing tradeoffs
checklist.description: response.md says the draft makes no tradeoffs: nothing in it is given up, and the commitments, such as supporting every team that asks, would not constrain any decision.

checklist.name: Explains what a strategy adds
checklist.description: response.md explains that a strategy would say how the goals will be reached and what the team gives up to reach them.

checklist.name: Does not rewrite the draft
checklist.description: response.md does not contain a rewritten or replacement strategy, and draft.md is unchanged. Questions back to the author or pointers on what to work out next are fine.
